21	/**
22	  * DMA Engine with TileLink-UL host (master) and device (CSR slave) ports.
23	  *
24	  * CSR Map (device port, 32-bit registers):
25	  *   0x00 : CTRL      (r/w)  - bit 0: enable, bit 1: start, bit 2: abort
26	  *   0x04 : STATUS    (r/o)  - bit 0: busy, bit 1: done, bit 2: error
27	  *   0x08 : DESC_ADDR (r/w)  - descriptor physical address
28	  *
29	  * Descriptor format (32 bytes at DESC_ADDR):
30	  *   +0x00 : src_addr   (32-bit)
31	  *   +0x04 : dst_addr   (32-bit)
32	  *   +0x08 : flags      bits[23:0]:xfer_len, bits[26:24]:xfer_width (log2 bytes/beat),
33	  *                      bit[27]:src_fixed, bit[28]:dst_fixed, bit[29]:poll_en
34	  *   +0x0c : next_desc  (32-bit, 0 = no chaining)
35	  *   +0x10 : poll_addr
36	  *   +0x14 : poll_mask
37	  *   +0x18 : poll_value
38	  *   +0x1c : reserved
39	  */
40	class DmaEngine(hostP: Parameters, deviceP: Parameters) extends Module {
41	  val hostTlp   = new TLULParameters(hostP)
42	  val deviceTlp = new TLULParameters(deviceP)
43	
44	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
45	    val tl_host   = new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(hostTlp)
46	    val tl_device = Flipped(new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(deviceTlp))
47	  })
48	
49	  // =========================================================================
50	  // CSR Registers
51	  // =========================================================================
52	  val ctrlReg     = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
53	  val statusReg   = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
54	  val descAddrReg = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
55	
56	  // =========================================================================
57	  // Device port TL-UL slave (CSR access)
58	  // =========================================================================
59	  val sDevIdle :: sDevResp :: Nil = Enum(2)
60	  val devState = RegInit(sDevIdle)
61	
62	  val devRespData   = RegInit(0.U(deviceTlp.dataBits.W))
63	  val devRespError  = RegInit(false.B)
64	  val devRespSource = RegInit(0.U(deviceTlp.sourceBits.W))
65	  val devRespSize   = RegInit(0.U(deviceTlp.sizeBits.W))
66	  val devRespOpcode = RegInit(TLULOpcodesD.AccessAck)
67	
68	  io.tl_device.a.ready := false.B
69	  io.tl_device.d.valid := false.B
70	  io.tl_device.d.bits  := 0.U.asTypeOf(new TLULChannelD(deviceTlp))
71	
72	  // Write enable signals decoded this cycle
73	  val devWriteCtrl     = WireDefault(false.B)
74	  val devWriteDescAddr = WireDefault(false.B)
75	  val devWriteData     = WireDefault(0.U(32.W))
76	  val devAbortReq      = WireDefault(false.B)
77	
78	  switch(devState) {
79	    is(sDevIdle) {
80	      io.tl_device.a.ready := true.B
81	      when(io.tl_device.a.valid) {
82	        val addr    = io.tl_device.a.bits.address
83	        val isWrite = (io.tl_device.a.bits.opcode === TLULOpcodesA.PutFullData) ||
84	                      (io.tl_device.a.bits.opcode === TLULOpcodesA.PutPartialData)
85	        val isGet   = io.tl_device.a.bits.opcode === TLULOpcodesA.Get
86	
87	        devRespSource := io.tl_device.a.bits.source
88	        devRespSize   := io.tl_device.a.bits.size
89	        devRespError  := false.B
90	        devRespData   := 0.U
91	
92	        when(isGet) {
93	          devRespOpcode := TLULOpcodesD.AccessAckData
94	          when(addr === 0x00.U) {
95	            devRespData := ctrlReg
96	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x04.U) {
97	            devRespData := statusReg
98	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x08.U) {
99	            devRespData := descAddrReg
100	          }.otherwise {
101	            devRespData  := 0.U
102	            devRespError := true.B
103	          }
104	        }.elsewhen(isWrite) {
105	          devRespOpcode := TLULOpcodesD.AccessAck
106	          when(addr === 0x04.U) {
107	            // STATUS is read-only
108	            devRespError := true.B
109	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x00.U) {
110	            devWriteCtrl := true.B
111	            devWriteData := io.tl_device.a.bits.data(31, 0)
112	            when(io.tl_device.a.bits.data(2)) {
113	              devAbortReq := true.B
114	            }
115	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x08.U) {
116	            devWriteDescAddr := true.B
117	            devWriteData     := io.tl_device.a.bits.data(31, 0)
118	          }.otherwise {
119	            devRespError := true.B
120	          }
121	        }.otherwise {
122	          devRespOpcode := TLULOpcodesD.AccessAck
123	          devRespError  := true.B
124	        }
125	
126	        devState := sDevResp
127	      }
128	    }
129	
130	    is(sDevResp) {
131	      io.tl_device.d.valid        := true.B
132	      io.tl_device.d.bits.opcode  := devRespOpcode
133	      io.tl_device.d.bits.param   := 0.U
134	      io.tl_device.d.bits.size    := devRespSize
135	      io.tl_device.d.bits.source  := devRespSource
136	      io.tl_device.d.bits.sink    := 0.U
137	      io.tl_device.d.bits.denied  := false.B
138	      io.tl_device.d.bits.data    := devRespData
139	      io.tl_device.d.bits.corrupt := false.B
140	      io.tl_device.d.bits.error   := devRespError
141	
142	      when(io.tl_device.d.ready) {
143	        devState := sDevIdle
144	      }
145	    }
146	  }
147	
148	  // =========================================================================
149	  // DMA FSM (host port master)
150	  // =========================================================================
151	  val dIdle      :: dLoadDesc  :: dWaitDesc  ::
152	      dXferRead  :: dWaitRead  ::
153	      dXferWrite :: dWaitWrite ::
154	      dDone      :: dError     :: Nil = Enum(9)
155	  val dmaState = RegInit(dIdle)
156	
157	  // Descriptor fields (latched from loading)
158	  val descSrcAddr   = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
159	  val descDstAddr   = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
160	  val descXferLen   = RegInit(0.U(24.W))
161	  val descXferWidth = RegInit(0.U(3.W))  // log2 bytes per beat
162	  val descSrcFixed  = RegInit(false.B)
163	  val descDstFixed  = RegInit(false.B)
164	  val descPollEn    = RegInit(false.B)
165	  val descNextDesc  = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
166	
167	  // Running transfer state
168	  val xferSrcAddr  = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
169	  val xferDstAddr  = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
170	  val xferRemain   = RegInit(0.U(32.W))  // bytes remaining
171	  val xferBeatSize = RegInit(4.U(32.W))  // bytes per beat
172	
173	  // Descriptor word loading (8 x 32-bit words)
174	  val descLoadIdx = RegInit(0.U(4.W))
175	  val descWords   = Reg(Vec(8, UInt(32.W)))
176	
177	  // Pending read data
178	  val readDataReg = RegInit(0.U(hostTlp.dataBits.W))
179	
180	  // Status bits
181	  val busyReg  = RegInit(false.B)
182	  val doneReg  = RegInit(false.B)
183	  val errorReg = RegInit(false.B)
184	
185	  statusReg := Cat(0.U(29.W), errorReg, doneReg, busyReg)
186	
187	  // Default host port outputs
188	  io.tl_host.a.valid     := false.B
189	  io.tl_host.a.bits      := 0.U.asTypeOf(new TLULChannelA(hostTlp))
190	  io.tl_host.d.ready     := false.B
191	
192	  // Number of bytes in address offset within bus word
193	  val busBytesLog2 = log2Ceil(hostTlp.dataBits / 8)
194	
195	  // Helper: log2 of beat size for TL-UL size field
196	  // beatSize must be a power-of-2 between 1 and busBytes
197	  def beatSizeToLog2(beatSize: UInt): UInt = {
198	    val result = WireDefault(2.U(4.W))
199	    val checks = Seq(1, 2, 4, 8, 16).map(s => (beatSize === s.U) -> log2Ceil(s).U(4.W))
200	    result := MuxCase(2.U(4.W), checks)
201	    result
202	  }
203	
204	  val curBeat  = Mux(xferRemain >= xferBeatSize, xferBeatSize, xferRemain)
205	  val curSizeLog2 = beatSizeToLog2(curBeat)
206	
207	  switch(dmaState) {
208	    is(dIdle) {
209	      when(devWriteCtrl && devWriteData(0) && devWriteData(1) && !busyReg) {
210	        busyReg   := true.B
211	        doneReg   := false.B
212	        errorReg  := false.B
213	        descLoadIdx := 0.U
214	        dmaState  := dLoadDesc
215	      }
216	    }
217	
218	    is(dLoadDesc) {
219	      when(devAbortReq) {
220	        busyReg  := false.B
221	        errorReg := true.B
222	        dmaState := dError
223	      }.otherwise {
224	        val loadAddr = descAddrReg + (descLoadIdx << 2.U)
225	        io.tl_host.a.valid        := true.B
226	        io.tl_host.a.bits.opcode  := TLULOpcodesA.Get
227	        io.tl_host.a.bits.param   := 0.U
228	        io.tl_host.a.bits.size    := 2.U  // 4 bytes
229	        io.tl_host.a.bits.source  := 0.U
230	        io.tl_host.a.bits.address := loadAddr
231	        io.tl_host.a.bits.mask    := 0xf.U << loadAddr(busBytesLog2 - 1, 0)
232	        io.tl_host.a.bits.data    := 0.U
233	        io.tl_host.a.bits.corrupt := false.B
234	
235	        when(io.tl_host.a.ready) {
236	          dmaState := dWaitDesc
237	        }
238	      }
239	    }
240	
241	    is(dWaitDesc) {
242	      io.tl_host.d.ready := true.B
243	      when(devAbortReq) {
244	        busyReg  := false.B
245	        errorReg := true.B
246	        dmaState := dError
247	      }.elsewhen(io.tl_host.d.valid) {
248	        val loadAddr   = descAddrReg + (descLoadIdx << 2.U)
249	        val byteOff    = loadAddr(busBytesLog2 - 1, 0)
250	        val bitOff     = byteOff << 3.U
251	        val word       = (io.tl_host.d.bits.data >> bitOff)(31, 0)
252	        descWords(descLoadIdx) := word
253	
254	        when(descLoadIdx === 7.U) {
255	          // Latch descriptor fields from accumulated words
256	          // word 2 flags is already from the last write on index 2
257	          val flags = descWords(2)
258	          descSrcAddr   := descWords(0)
259	          descDstAddr   := descWords(1)
260	          descXferLen   := flags(23, 0)
261	          descXferWidth := flags(26, 24)
262	          descSrcFixed  := flags(27)
263	          descDstFixed  := flags(28)
264	          descPollEn    := flags(29)
265	          descNextDesc  := descWords(3)
266	
267	          xferSrcAddr   := descWords(0)
268	          xferDstAddr   := descWords(1)
269	          xferRemain    := flags(23, 0)
270	          xferBeatSize  := 1.U << flags(26, 24)
271	
272	          dmaState := dXferRead
273	        }.otherwise {
274	          descLoadIdx := descLoadIdx + 1.U
275	          dmaState    := dLoadDesc
276	        }
277	      }
278	    }
279	
280	    is(dXferRead) {
281	      when(devAbortReq) {
282	        busyReg  := false.B
283	        errorReg := true.B
284	        dmaState := dError
285	      }.elsewhen(xferRemain === 0.U) {
286	        when(descNextDesc =/= 0.U) {
287	          descAddrReg := descNextDesc
288	          descLoadIdx := 0.U
289	          dmaState    := dLoadDesc
290	        }.otherwise {
291	          busyReg  := false.B
292	          doneReg  := true.B
293	          dmaState := dDone
294	        }
295	      }.otherwise {
296	        io.tl_host.a.valid        := true.B
297	        io.tl_host.a.bits.opcode  := TLULOpcodesA.Get
298	        io.tl_host.a.bits.param   := 0.U
299	        io.tl_host.a.bits.size    := curSizeLog2
300	        io.tl_host.a.bits.source  := 1.U
301	        io.tl_host.a.bits.address := xferSrcAddr
302	        io.tl_host.a.bits.mask    := ((1.U << curBeat) - 1.U) << xferSrcAddr(busBytesLog2 - 1, 0)
303	        io.tl_host.a.bits.data    := 0.U
304	        io.tl_host.a.bits.corrupt := false.B
305	
306	        when(io.tl_host.a.ready) {
307	          dmaState := dWaitRead
308	        }
309	      }
310	    }
311	
312	    is(dWaitRead) {
313	      io.tl_host.d.ready := true.B
314	      when(devAbortReq) {
315	        busyReg  := false.B
316	        errorReg := true.B
317	        dmaState := dError
318	      }.elsewhen(io.tl_host.d.valid) {
319	        readDataReg := io.tl_host.d.bits.data
320	        dmaState    := dXferWrite
321	      }
322	    }
323	
324	    is(dXferWrite) {
325	      when(devAbortReq) {
326	        busyReg  := false.B
327	        errorReg := true.B
328	        dmaState := dError
329	      }.otherwise {
330	        // src data is in readDataReg at srcByteOffset within the bus word
331	        // dst data should be placed at dstByteOffset within the bus word
332	        val srcByteOff = xferSrcAddr(busBytesLog2 - 1, 0)
333	        val dstByteOff = xferDstAddr(busBytesLog2 - 1, 0)
334	
335	        // Extract the relevant bytes from the source bus word and re-place at dst offset
336	        val byteMask   = ((1.U << curBeat) - 1.U)
337	        val dstMaskShifted = byteMask << dstByteOff
338	
339	        // Shift data: extract from src position, place at dst position
340	        val srcData     = readDataReg >> (srcByteOff << 3.U)
341	        val dstData     = srcData << (dstByteOff << 3.U)
342	
343	        io.tl_host.a.valid        := true.B
344	        io.tl_host.a.bits.opcode  := TLULOpcodesA.PutFullData
345	        io.tl_host.a.bits.param   := 0.U
346	        io.tl_host.a.bits.size    := curSizeLog2
347	        io.tl_host.a.bits.source  := 2.U
348	        io.tl_host.a.bits.address := xferDstAddr
349	        io.tl_host.a.bits.mask    := dstMaskShifted
350	        io.tl_host.a.bits.data    := dstData
351	        io.tl_host.a.bits.corrupt := false.B
352	
353	        when(io.tl_host.a.ready) {
354	          dmaState := dWaitWrite
355	        }
356	      }
357	    }
358	
359	    is(dWaitWrite) {
360	      io.tl_host.d.ready := true.B
361	      when(devAbortReq) {
362	        busyReg  := false.B
363	        errorReg := true.B
364	        dmaState := dError
365	      }.elsewhen(io.tl_host.d.valid) {
366	        when(!descSrcFixed) {
367	          xferSrcAddr := xferSrcAddr + curBeat
368	        }
369	        when(!descDstFixed) {
370	          xferDstAddr := xferDstAddr + curBeat
371	        }
372	        xferRemain := xferRemain - curBeat
373	        dmaState   := dXferRead
374	      }
375	    }
376	
377	    is(dDone) { /* terminal */ }
378	    is(dError) { /* terminal */ }
379	  }
380	
381	  // =========================================================================
382	  // CSR register writes
383	  // =========================================================================
384	  when(devWriteCtrl) {
385	    ctrlReg := devWriteData
386	    when(devWriteData(2)) {
387	      // Abort clears busy, sets error
388	      busyReg  := false.B
389	      errorReg := true.B
390	      dmaState := dError
391	    }.elsewhen(devWriteData(0) && devWriteData(1) && !busyReg) {
392	      // enable+start triggers DMA (handled in dIdle state above)
393	    }
394	  }
395	  when(devWriteDescAddr) {
396	    descAddrReg := devWriteData
397	  }
398	}

17	import chisel3._
18	import chisel3.util._

21	/** SPI physical IO signals. */
22	class SpiIO extends Bundle {
23	  val sclk = Output(Bool())
24	  val mosi = Output(Bool())
25	  val miso = Input(Bool())
26	  val csb  = Output(Bool())  // chip-select bar (active low)
27	}
28	
29	/**
30	  * SPI Master Controller with TL-UL CSR interface.
31	  *
32	  * CSR Map:
33	  *   0x00 : STATUS   (r/o)  - bit 0: busy, bit 1: rx_empty
34	  *   0x04 : CONTROL  (r/w)  - bit 0: enable, bit 1: cpol, bit 2: cpha,
35	  *                            bit 3: hdrx (half-duplex RX), bit 4: hdtx (half-duplex TX),
36	  *                            bits[15:8]: div (baud rate divisor)
37	  *   0x08 : TXDATA   (w/o)  - write a byte to transmit FIFO
38	  *   0x0c : RXDATA   (r/o)  - read a byte from receive FIFO (stalls if empty)
39	  *   0x10 : CSID     (r/w)  - chip select control: 0=deassert, 1=assert (in manual mode)
40	  *   0x14 : CSMODE   (r/w)  - 0=auto, 1=manual
41	  *
42	  * Writes to STATUS (0x00) return error. Reads from TXDATA (0x08) return error.
43	  * Reads from RXDATA (0x0c) stall channel A until data is available.
44	  * Writes to TXDATA stall channel A if TX FIFO is full.
45	  */
46	class SpiMasterCtrl(p: Parameters) extends Module {
47	  val tlp = new TLULParameters(p)
48	
49	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
50	    val tl  = Flipped(new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(tlp))
51	    val spi = new SpiIO
52	  })
53	
54	  // =========================================================================
55	  // Configuration registers
56	  // =========================================================================
57	  val ctrlReg   = RegInit(0.U(16.W))
58	  val csidReg   = RegInit(0.U(1.W))
59	  val csmodeReg = RegInit(0.U(1.W))
60	
61	  val spiEnable = ctrlReg(0)
62	  val cpol      = ctrlReg(1)
63	  val cpha      = ctrlReg(2)
64	  val hdrx      = ctrlReg(3)   // half-duplex RX
65	  val hdtx      = ctrlReg(4)   // half-duplex TX
66	  val divider   = ctrlReg(15, 8)  // baud rate divisor
67	
68	  // =========================================================================
69	  // TX and RX FIFOs (depth 4)
70	  // =========================================================================
71	  val TX_DEPTH = 4
72	  val RX_DEPTH = 4
73	
74	  val txFifo   = Module(new Queue(UInt(8.W), TX_DEPTH))
75	  val rxFifo   = Module(new Queue(UInt(8.W), RX_DEPTH))
76	
77	  // =========================================================================
78	  // SPI FSM
79	  // =========================================================================
80	  val spiIdle :: spiCS :: spiBit :: spiDone :: Nil = Enum(4)
81	  val spiState = RegInit(spiIdle)
82	
83	  val sclkReg    = RegInit(false.B)
84	  val mosiReg    = RegInit(false.B)
85	  val csbReg     = RegInit(true.B)
86	  val shiftReg   = RegInit(0.U(8.W))
87	  val rxShift    = RegInit(0.U(8.W))
88	  val bitCnt     = RegInit(0.U(4.W))  // 0..7
89	  val halfCnt    = RegInit(0.U(8.W))  // half-period counter
90	  val txByte     = RegInit(0.U(8.W))
91	  val spiHalfPeriod = WireDefault((divider +& 1.U)(7, 0))
92	
93	  // CS logic
94	  val manualCS  = csmodeReg === 1.U
95	  val autoCSActive = spiState =/= spiIdle && !manualCS
96	
97	  io.spi.sclk := sclkReg
98	  io.spi.mosi := mosiReg
99	  io.spi.csb  := Mux(manualCS, (csidReg === 0.U), !autoCSActive)
100	
101	  val txHasData  = txFifo.io.deq.valid
102	  val rxFull     = !rxFifo.io.enq.ready
103	  val rxEmpty    = !rxFifo.io.deq.valid
104	
105	  txFifo.io.enq.valid := false.B
106	  txFifo.io.enq.bits  := 0.U
107	  txFifo.io.deq.ready := false.B
108	
109	  rxFifo.io.enq.valid := false.B
110	  rxFifo.io.enq.bits  := 0.U
111	  rxFifo.io.deq.ready := false.B
112	
113	  // SPI is busy when in non-idle states
114	  val spiBusy = spiState =/= spiIdle
115	
116	  // Has TX data to send or in half-duplex RX mode (continuous clocking)
117	  val canStartTx = txHasData || hdrx
118	
119	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
120	  // SPI clock generation and bit shifting FSM
121	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
122	  switch(spiState) {
123	    is(spiIdle) {
124	      sclkReg := cpol  // idle polarity
125	      when(spiEnable && canStartTx && !rxFull) {
126	        when(txHasData) {
127	          txFifo.io.deq.ready := true.B
128	          shiftReg := txFifo.io.deq.bits
129	          txByte   := txFifo.io.deq.bits
130	        }.otherwise {
131	          shiftReg := 0.U
132	          txByte   := 0.U
133	        }
134	        rxShift  := 0.U
135	        bitCnt   := 0.U
136	        halfCnt  := 0.U
137	        spiState := spiBit
138	        // Drive MOSI with MSB immediately
139	        mosiReg := Mux(txHasData, txFifo.io.deq.bits(7), false.B)
140	      }
141	    }
142	
143	    is(spiBit) {
144	      // Increment half-period counter
145	      halfCnt := halfCnt + 1.U
146	      when(halfCnt >= spiHalfPeriod - 1.U) {
147	        halfCnt  := 0.U
148	        sclkReg  := !sclkReg
149	
150	        // On leading edge (CPOL=0: 0->1, CPOL=1: 1->0)
151	        val leadEdge = Mux(cpol, sclkReg, !sclkReg)  // sclkReg is about to toggle
152	        // On trailing edge
153	        val trailEdge = !leadEdge
154	
155	        // Sample MISO on the appropriate edge
156	        // Mode 0 (CPOL=0, CPHA=0): sample on rising (leading)
157	        // Mode 1 (CPOL=0, CPHA=1): sample on falling (trailing)
158	        // Mode 2 (CPOL=1, CPHA=0): sample on falling (leading)
159	        // Mode 3 (CPOL=1, CPHA=1): sample on rising (trailing)
160	        val sampleNow = Mux(cpha, trailEdge, leadEdge)
161	        val shiftNow  = !sampleNow  // shift MOSI on opposite edge
162	
163	        when(sampleNow) {
164	          // Shift in MISO MSB first
165	          rxShift := Cat(rxShift(6, 0), io.spi.miso)
166	        }
167	
168	        when(shiftNow) {
169	          // After sampling, shift out next bit
170	          val nextBit = Mux(bitCnt < 7.U, bitCnt + 1.U, bitCnt)
171	          mosiReg  := shiftReg(6.U - Mux(bitCnt < 7.U, bitCnt, 6.U))
172	        }
173	
174	        // Count half-periods: 16 half-periods = 8 full bits
175	        when(bitCnt === 15.U) {
176	          bitCnt   := 0.U
177	          spiState := spiDone
178	        }.otherwise {
179	          bitCnt := bitCnt + 1.U
180	        }
181	      }
182	    }
183	
184	    is(spiDone) {
185	      sclkReg := cpol
186	      // Store received byte if not in HDTX mode (TX-only half duplex)
187	      when(!hdtx) {
188	        when(rxFifo.io.enq.ready) {
189	          rxFifo.io.enq.valid := true.B
190	          rxFifo.io.enq.bits  := rxShift
191	          // Check if more data to send or in HDRX mode
192	          when(spiEnable && canStartTx && !rxFull) {
193	            when(txHasData) {
194	              txFifo.io.deq.ready := true.B
195	              shiftReg := txFifo.io.deq.bits
196	              txByte   := txFifo.io.deq.bits
197	              mosiReg  := txFifo.io.deq.bits(7)
198	            }.otherwise {
199	              shiftReg := 0.U
200	              txByte   := 0.U
201	              mosiReg  := false.B
202	            }
203	            rxShift  := 0.U
204	            bitCnt   := 0.U
205	            halfCnt  := 0.U
206	            spiState := spiBit
207	          }.otherwise {
208	            spiState := spiIdle
209	          }
210	        }.otherwise {
211	          // Stall: RX FIFO full, wait
212	        }
213	      }.otherwise {
214	        // HDTX: discard RX, continue
215	        when(spiEnable && canStartTx) {
216	          when(txHasData) {
217	            txFifo.io.deq.ready := true.B
218	            shiftReg := txFifo.io.deq.bits
219	            txByte   := txFifo.io.deq.bits
220	            mosiReg  := txFifo.io.deq.bits(7)
221	          }.otherwise {
222	            spiState := spiIdle
223	          }
224	          rxShift  := 0.U
225	          bitCnt   := 0.U
226	          halfCnt  := 0.U
227	          when(txHasData) {
228	            spiState := spiBit
229	          }
230	        }.otherwise {
231	          spiState := spiIdle
232	        }
233	      }
234	    }
235	  }
236	
237	  // =========================================================================
238	  // Status register
239	  // =========================================================================
240	  val statusReg = Cat(rxEmpty, spiBusy)
241	
242	  // =========================================================================
243	  // TL-UL CSR Slave
244	  // =========================================================================
245	  val sTLIdle :: sTLResp :: Nil = Enum(2)
246	  val tlState = RegInit(sTLIdle)
247	
248	  val tlRespData   = RegInit(0.U(tlp.dataBits.W))
249	  val tlRespError  = RegInit(false.B)
250	  val tlRespSource = RegInit(0.U(tlp.sourceBits.W))
251	  val tlRespSize   = RegInit(0.U(tlp.sizeBits.W))
252	  val tlRespOpcode = RegInit(TLULOpcodesD.AccessAck)
253	
254	  io.tl.a.ready := false.B
255	  io.tl.d.valid := false.B
256	  io.tl.d.bits  := 0.U.asTypeOf(new TLULChannelD(tlp))
257	
258	  // Stall conditions: reading RXDATA when empty or writing TXDATA when full
259	  val txWriteStall = WireDefault(false.B)
260	  val rxReadStall  = WireDefault(false.B)
261	
262	  switch(tlState) {
263	    is(sTLIdle) {
264	      val addr    = io.tl.a.bits.address
265	      val isWrite = (io.tl.a.bits.opcode === TLULOpcodesA.PutFullData) ||
266	                    (io.tl.a.bits.opcode === TLULOpcodesA.PutPartialData)
267	      val isGet   = io.tl.a.bits.opcode === TLULOpcodesA.Get
268	
269	      // Compute stall conditions combinationally
270	      when(io.tl.a.valid) {
271	        txWriteStall := isWrite && addr === 0x08.U && !txFifo.io.enq.ready
272	        rxReadStall  := isGet  && addr === 0x0c.U && rxEmpty
273	      }
274	
275	      // Accept if no stall
276	      io.tl.a.ready := io.tl.a.valid && !txWriteStall && !rxReadStall
277	
278	      when(io.tl.a.valid && !txWriteStall && !rxReadStall) {
279	        tlRespSource := io.tl.a.bits.source
280	        tlRespSize   := io.tl.a.bits.size
281	        tlRespError  := false.B
282	        tlRespData   := 0.U
283	
284	        when(isGet) {
285	          tlRespOpcode := TLULOpcodesD.AccessAckData
286	          when(addr === 0x00.U) {
287	            tlRespData := statusReg
288	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x04.U) {
289	            tlRespData := ctrlReg
290	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x0c.U) {
291	            // Pop from RX FIFO (ready was checked above, not empty)
292	            rxFifo.io.deq.ready := true.B
293	            tlRespData := rxFifo.io.deq.bits
294	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x10.U) {
295	            tlRespData := csidReg
296	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x14.U) {
297	            tlRespData := csmodeReg
298	          }.otherwise {
299	            tlRespData  := 0.U
300	            tlRespError := true.B
301	          }
302	        }.elsewhen(isWrite) {
303	          tlRespOpcode := TLULOpcodesD.AccessAck
304	          when(addr === 0x00.U) {
305	            // STATUS is read-only
306	            tlRespError := true.B
307	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x04.U) {
308	            ctrlReg := io.tl.a.bits.data(15, 0)
309	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x08.U) {
310	            // Push to TX FIFO (space was checked above)
311	            txFifo.io.enq.valid := true.B
312	            txFifo.io.enq.bits  := io.tl.a.bits.data(7, 0)
313	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x10.U) {
314	            csidReg := io.tl.a.bits.data(0)
315	          }.elsewhen(addr === 0x14.U) {
316	            csmodeReg := io.tl.a.bits.data(0)
317	          }.otherwise {
318	            tlRespError := true.B
319	          }
320	        }.otherwise {
321	          tlRespOpcode := TLULOpcodesD.AccessAck
322	          tlRespError  := true.B
323	        }
324	
325	        tlState := sTLResp
326	      }
327	    }
328	
329	    is(sTLResp) {
330	      io.tl.d.valid        := true.B
331	      io.tl.d.bits.opcode  := tlRespOpcode
332	      io.tl.d.bits.param   := 0.U
333	      io.tl.d.bits.size    := tlRespSize
334	      io.tl.d.bits.source  := tlRespSource
335	      io.tl.d.bits.sink    := 0.U
336	      io.tl.d.bits.denied  := false.B
337	      io.tl.d.bits.data    := tlRespData
338	      io.tl.d.bits.corrupt := false.B
339	      io.tl.d.bits.error   := tlRespError
340	
341	      when(io.tl.d.ready) {
342	        tlState := sTLIdle
343	      }
344	    }
345	  }
346	}
347	
348	/**
349	  * SPI Master top-level with explicit clock and reset ports for CDC crossing.
350	  * Wraps SpiMasterCtrl with explicit clock domain inputs.
351	  */
352	class SpiMaster(p: Parameters) extends RawModule {
353	  val tlp = new TLULParameters(p)
354	
355	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
356	    val clk_i   = Input(Clock())
357	    val rst_ni  = Input(AsyncReset())
358	    val tl      = Flipped(new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(tlp))
359	    val spi     = new SpiIO
360	    val spi_clk_i = Input(Clock())
361	  })
362	
363	  withClockAndReset(io.clk_i, io.rst_ni) {
364	    val ctrl = Module(new SpiMasterCtrl(p))
365	    ctrl.io.tl  <> io.tl
366	    io.spi      <> ctrl.io.spi
367	  }
368	}

22	/** Test suite for SPI Master implementation.
23	  *
24	  * Covers register access, data path (loopback), baud rate timing, manual chip-select control, and
25	  * asynchronous clock domain crossing.
26	  */
27	class SpiMasterSpec extends AnyFreeSpec with ChiselSim with TLULTestUtils {
28	  val p = new Parameters
29	
30	  "SpiMaster Register Access" in {
31	    simulate(new SpiMasterCtrl(p)) { dut =>
32	      dut.reset.poke(true.B)
33	      dut.clock.step()
34	      dut.reset.poke(false.B)
35	
36	      tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x04.U, 0x1234.U) // CONTROL
37	      val rdata = tlReadData(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x04.U)
38	      assert(rdata == 0x1234)
39	    }
40	  }
41	
42	  "SpiMaster Loopback" in {
43	    simulate(new SpiMasterCtrl(p)) { dut =>
44	      dut.reset.poke(true.B)
45	      dut.clock.step()
46	      dut.reset.poke(false.B)
47	
48	      // Enable SPI
49	      tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x04.U, 0x01.U) // ENABLE=1
50	      tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x08.U, 0x55.U) // TXDATA=0x55
51	
52	      // Sample MOSI and feed back to MISO to simulate wire loopback
53	      for (_ <- 0 until 100) {
54	        dut.io.spi.miso.poke(dut.io.spi.mosi.peek())
55	        dut.clock.step()
56	      }
57	
58	      // Verify RX FIFO status is non-empty
59	      val status = tlReadData(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x00.U)
60	      assert((status & 2) == 0, s"RX FIFO should not be empty, status=$status")
61	
62	      // Check captured data
63	      val rxdata = tlReadData(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x0c.U)
64	      assert(rxdata == 0x55, s"Expected 0x55, got 0x${rxdata.toString(16)}")
65	    }
66	  }
67	
68	  "SpiMaster DIV Timing" in {
69	    simulate(new SpiMasterCtrl(p)) { dut =>
70	      dut.reset.poke(true.B)
71	      dut.clock.step()
72	      dut.reset.poke(false.B)
73	
74	      // Configure DIV=3: SCLK period = (DIV+1)*2 = 8 cycles
75	      // Standard Mode 0 (CPOL=0) results in sclk_reg=0 at idle
76	      tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x04.U, 0x0301.U) // ENABLE=1, DIV=3, CPOL=0
77	      tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x08.U, 0xaa.U)
78	
79	      // Wait for first edge (0 -> 1 for standard CPOL=0)
80	      while (dut.io.spi.sclk.peek().litValue == 0) dut.clock.step()
81	      var steps = 0
82	      // Measure duration of '1' phase
83	      while (dut.io.spi.sclk.peek().litValue == 1) {
84	        dut.clock.step()
85	        steps += 1
86	      }
87	      // Measure duration of '0' phase
88	      while (dut.io.spi.sclk.peek().litValue == 0) {
89	        dut.clock.step()
90	        steps += 1
91	      }
92	      assert(steps == 8, s"Expected period 8, got $steps")
93	    }
94	  }
95	
96	  "SpiMaster Manual CS" in {
97	    simulate(new SpiMasterCtrl(p)) { dut =>
98	      dut.reset.poke(true.B)
99	      dut.clock.step()
100	      dut.reset.poke(false.B)
101	
102	      // Explicitly control CS line via CSID and CSMODE
103	      tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x14.U, 0x01.U) // CSMODE=Manual
104	      tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x10.U, 0x01.U) // CSID=0 active
105	      tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x04.U, 0x01.U) // ENABLE=1
106	
107	      dut.clock.step(10)
108	      assert(dut.io.spi.csb.peek().litValue == 0, "CS should stay asserted in manual mode")
109	
110	      tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x10.U, 0x00.U) // Deassert
111	      dut.clock.step(10)
112	      assert(dut.io.spi.csb.peek().litValue == 1, "CS should stay deasserted in manual mode")
113	    }
114	  }
115	
116	  "SpiMaster Top-level Async Clocks" in {
117	    val tlul_p = new TLULParameters(p)
118	    simulate(new Module {
119	      val io = IO(new Bundle {
120	        val tl         = Flipped(new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(tlul_p))
121	        val spi        = new SpiIO
122	        val spi_clk_in = Input(Bool())
123	      })
124	      val dut = Module(new SpiMaster(p))
125	      dut.io.clk_i  := clock
126	      dut.io.rst_ni := (!reset.asBool).asAsyncReset
127	      dut.io.tl <> io.tl
128	      io.spi <> dut.io.spi
129	      dut.io.spi_clk_i := io.spi_clk_in.asClock
130	    }) { dut =>
131	      dut.reset.poke(true.B)
132	      dut.clock.step()
133	      dut.reset.poke(false.B)
134	
135	      var spi_clk_val = false
136	
137	      /** Helper to step both system bus and SPI clock domains.
138	        */
139	      def stepBoth(n: Int = 1): Unit = {
140	        for (_ <- 0 until n) {
141	          dut.clock.step()
142	          spi_clk_val = !spi_clk_val
143	          dut.io.spi_clk_in.poke(spi_clk_val.B)
144	        }
145	      }
146	
147	      /** Specialized TileLink helper for CDC crossing test.
148	        */
149	      def tlWriteAsync(addr: UInt, data: UInt): Unit = {
150	        dut.io.tl.a.valid.poke(true.B)
151	        dut.io.tl.a.bits.opcode.poke(TLULOpcodesA.PutFullData.asUInt)
152	        dut.io.tl.a.bits.address.poke(addr)
153	        dut.io.tl.a.bits.data.poke(data)
154	        dut.io.tl.a.bits.mask.poke(0xf.U)
155	        while (dut.io.tl.a.ready.peek().litValue == 0) stepBoth()
156	        stepBoth()
157	        dut.io.tl.a.valid.poke(false.B)
158	        while (dut.io.tl.d.valid.peek().litValue == 0) stepBoth()
159	        dut.io.tl.d.ready.poke(true.B)
160	        stepBoth()
161	        dut.io.tl.d.ready.poke(false.B)
162	      }
163	
164	      tlWriteAsync(0x04.U, 0x01.U) // Enable
165	      stepBoth(40)
166	      tlWriteAsync(0x08.U, 0x33.U) // Send byte
167	
168	      var seen = 0
169	      for (_ <- 0 until 400) {
170	        stepBoth()
171	        if (dut.io.spi.csb.peek().litValue == 0) seen += 1
172	      }
173	      assert(seen > 0, "SPI logic did not activate across CDC bridge")
174	    }
175	  }
176	
177	  "SpiMaster TX Backpressure" in {
178	    simulate(new SpiMasterCtrl(p)) { dut =>
179	      dut.reset.poke(true.B)
180	      dut.clock.step()
181	      dut.reset.poke(false.B)
182	
183	      // Saturation test: fill FIFO and verify channel A stall
184	      for (i <- 0 until 4) {
185	        tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x08.U, i.U)
186	      }
187	
188	      dut.io.tl.a.valid.poke(true.B)
189	      dut.io.tl.a.bits.address.poke(0x08.U)
190	      dut.clock.step()
191	      assert(dut.io.tl.a.ready.peek().litValue == 0, "Host should be stalled when TX FIFO is full")
192	      dut.io.tl.a.valid.poke(false.B)
193	    }
194	  }
195	
196	  "SpiMaster RX Blocking Read" in {
197	    simulate(new SpiMasterCtrl(p)) { dut =>
198	      dut.reset.poke(true.B)
199	      dut.clock.step()
200	      dut.reset.poke(false.B)
201	
202	      // Verification of atomic synchronization: reading from empty RXDATA stalls the bus
203	      dut.io.tl.a.valid.poke(true.B)
204	      dut.io.tl.a.bits.address.poke(0x0c.U)
205	      dut.clock.step()
206	      assert(
207	        dut.io.tl.a.ready.peek().litValue == 0,
208	        "Host should be stalled when reading empty RX FIFO"
209	      )
210	      dut.io.tl.a.valid.poke(false.B)
211	    }
212	  }
213	
214	  "SpiMaster RX Overflow Stall" in {
215	    simulate(new SpiMasterCtrl(p)) { dut =>
216	      dut.reset.poke(true.B)
217	      dut.clock.step()
218	      dut.reset.poke(false.B)
219	
220	      tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x04.U, 0x0101.U) // Baud rate scaling
221	
222	      // Saturate RX path
223	      for (i <- 0 until 4) {
224	        tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x08.U, (0xa0 + i).U)
225	        for (_ <- 0 until 100) {
226	          dut.io.spi.miso.poke(dut.io.spi.mosi.peek())
227	          dut.clock.step()
228	        }
229	      }
230	
231	      // 5th byte should hang until space is cleared
232	      tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x08.U, 0xee.U)
233	      for (_ <- 0 until 200) {
234	        dut.io.spi.miso.poke(dut.io.spi.mosi.peek())
235	        dut.clock.step()
236	      }
237	
238	      val sclk1 = dut.io.spi.sclk.peek().litValue
239	      dut.clock.step(20)
240	      val sclk2 = dut.io.spi.sclk.peek().litValue
241	      assert(sclk1 == sclk2, "SPI FSM should be stalled awaiting RX FIFO availability")
242	
243	      // Clear space and verify resumption
244	      tlReadData(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x0c.U)
245	      for (_ <- 0 until 100) {
246	        dut.io.spi.miso.poke(dut.io.spi.mosi.peek())
247	        dut.clock.step()
248	      }
249	      val status = tlReadData(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x00.U)
250	      assert((status & 2) == 0, "Transaction should have finalized after FIFO read")
251	    }
252	  }
253	
254	  "SpiMaster Invalid Address Access" in {
255	    simulate(new SpiMasterCtrl(p)) { dut =>
256	      dut.reset.poke(true.B)
257	      dut.clock.step()
258	      dut.reset.poke(false.B)
259	
260	      // Get error on invalid address
261	      val (_, error) = tlRead(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x100.U)
262	      assert(error, "Invalid address access should return error")
263	
264	      // Get error on write to read-only register
265	      dut.io.tl.a.valid.poke(true.B)
266	      dut.io.tl.a.bits.opcode.poke(TLULOpcodesA.PutFullData.asUInt)
267	      dut.io.tl.a.bits.address.poke(0x00.U) // STATUS is RO
268	      dut.io.tl.a.bits.data.poke(1.U)
269	      while (dut.io.tl.a.ready.peek().litValue == 0) dut.clock.step()
270	      dut.clock.step()
271	      dut.io.tl.a.valid.poke(false.B)
272	      while (dut.io.tl.d.valid.peek().litValue == 0) dut.clock.step()
273	      assert(
274	        dut.io.tl.d.bits.error.peek().litValue != 0,
275	        "Write to RO register should return error"
276	      )
277	    }
278	  }
279	
280	  "SpiMaster Mode 0 Sampling Verification" in {
281	    simulate(new SpiMasterCtrl(p)) { dut =>
282	      dut.reset.poke(true.B)
283	      dut.clock.step()
284	      dut.reset.poke(false.B)
285	
286	      // Configure Mode 0 (CPOL=0, CPHA=0)
287	      tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x04.U, 0x01.U) // ENABLE=1, CPOL=0, CPHA=0
288	      tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x08.U, 0x88.U) // Send 10001000
289	
290	      // Wait for bit shifting to start
291	      while (dut.io.spi.csb.peek().litValue == 1) dut.clock.step()
292	
293	      // In Mode 0, data is driven by slave immediately on CS assertion.
294	      // Master must sample on the first available leading clock edge.
295	      for (_ <- 0 until 200) {
296	        // Simple loopback: MISO = MOSI
297	        dut.io.spi.miso.poke(dut.io.spi.mosi.peek())
298	        dut.clock.step()
299	      }
300	
301	      val rxdata = tlReadData(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x0c.U)
302	      assert(rxdata == 0x88, s"Expected 0x88, got 0x${rxdata.toString(16)}")
303	    }
304	  }
305	
306	  "SpiMaster Multi-Mode Verification" in {
307	    // Test all 4 SPI modes (CPOL=0/1, CPHA=0/1)
308	    for (mode <- 0 until 4) {
309	      val cpol     = (mode >> 1) & 1
310	      val cpha     = mode & 1
311	      val ctrl_val = (cpol << 1) | (cpha << 2) | 1 // ENABLE=1
312	
313	      simulate(new SpiMasterCtrl(p)) { dut =>
314	        dut.reset.poke(true.B)
315	        dut.clock.step()
316	        dut.reset.poke(false.B)
317	
318	        tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x04.U, ctrl_val.U)
319	        tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x08.U, 0xa5.U)
320	
321	        while (dut.io.spi.csb.peek().litValue == 1) dut.clock.step()
322	
323	        // Wait enough time for the transfer to complete
324	        for (_ <- 0 until 500) {
325	          dut.io.spi.miso.poke(dut.io.spi.mosi.peek())
326	          dut.clock.step()
327	        }
328	
329	        val rxdata = tlReadData(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x0c.U)
330	        assert(
331	          rxdata == 0xa5,
332	          s"Mode $mode (CPOL=$cpol, CPHA=$cpha) failed: expected 0xa5, got 0x${rxdata.toString(16)}"
333	        )
334	      }
335	    }
336	  }
337	
338	  "SpiMaster Half-Duplex RX Mode" in {
339	    simulate(new SpiMasterCtrl(p)) { dut =>
340	      dut.reset.poke(true.B)
341	      dut.clock.step()
342	      dut.reset.poke(false.B)
343	
344	      // Enable SPI with HDRX (bit 3)
345	      // Div=2, HDRX=1, Enable=1 -> 0x0209
346	      tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x04.U, 0x0209.U)
347	
348	      // In HDRX, SPI should start generating SCLK as long as RX FIFO is not full,
349	      // without needing a write to TXDATA.
350	      var sclk_edges = 0
351	      var last_sclk  = false
352	      for (_ <- 0 until 500) {
353	        val sclk = dut.io.spi.sclk.peek().litValue != 0
354	        if (sclk && !last_sclk) sclk_edges += 1
355	        last_sclk = sclk
356	
357	        // Simple loopback: MISO = bit count (mocking some external data)
358	        dut.io.spi.miso.poke(true.B) // Just send all 1s for simplicity
359	        dut.clock.step()
360	      }
361	
362	      assert(sclk_edges >= 8, "SCLK should have toggled in half-duplex mode")
363	
364	      // Check that data was captured
365	      val status = tlReadData(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x00.U)
366	      assert((status & 2) == 0, "RX FIFO should have data")
367	
368	      val rxdata = tlReadData(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x0c.U)
369	      assert(rxdata == 0xff, s"Expected 0xFF from all-1s loopback, got 0x${rxdata.toString(16)}")
370	    }
371	  }
372	
373	  "SpiMaster Half-Duplex TX Mode" in {
374	    simulate(new SpiMasterCtrl(p)) { dut =>
375	      dut.reset.poke(true.B)
376	      dut.clock.step()
377	      dut.reset.poke(false.B)
378	
379	      // Enable SPI with HDTX (bit 4)
380	      // Div=2, HDTX=1, Enable=1 -> 0x0211
381	      tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x04.U, 0x0211.U)
382	
383	      // Write 8 bytes to TXDATA. With an RX FIFO of size 4, this would
384	      // normally stall if RX wasn't being drained. In HDTX mode, it should
385	      // proceed without stalls and without filling the RX FIFO.
386	      for (i <- 0 until 8) {
387	        tlWrite(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x08.U, i.U)
388	        // Wait for byte to finish (busy bit in status)
389	        var status = tlReadData(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x00.U)
390	        while ((status & 1) != 0) {
391	          dut.clock.step()
392	          status = tlReadData(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x00.U)
393	        }
394	      }
395	
396	      // Check that RX FIFO is still empty
397	      val status = tlReadData(dut.io.tl, dut.clock, 0x00.U)
398	      assert((status & 2) != 0, "RX FIFO should be empty in HDTX mode")
399	    }
400	  }
401	}

21	/**
22	  * TileLink-UL M-to-1 socket (arbitrated multiplexer).
23	  *
24	  * Accepts requests from M hosts and forwards them to a single device,
25	  * using round-robin arbitration. Responses are routed back to the
26	  * originating host based on the source ID tag.
27	  */
28	class TlulSocketM1(p: Parameters, nHosts: Int) extends Module {
29	  val tlp = new TLULParameters(p)
30	
31	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
32	    val host   = Vec(nHosts, Flipped(new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(tlp)))
33	    val device = new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(tlp)
34	  })
35	
36	  val arbiter = Module(new RRArbiter(new TLULChannelA(tlp), nHosts))
37	
38	  for (i <- 0 until nHosts) {
39	    arbiter.io.in(i).valid := io.host(i).a.valid
40	    arbiter.io.in(i).bits  := io.host(i).a.bits
41	    io.host(i).a.ready     := arbiter.io.in(i).ready
42	  }
43	
44	  // Tag the source with host index (encode in upper bits of source)
45	  val taggedA  = Wire(new TLULChannelA(tlp))
46	  taggedA      := arbiter.io.out.bits
47	  taggedA.source := Cat(arbiter.io.chosen, arbiter.io.out.bits.source(tlp.sourceBits - log2Ceil(nHosts) - 2, 0))
48	
49	  io.device.a.valid := arbiter.io.out.valid
50	  io.device.a.bits  := taggedA
51	  arbiter.io.out.ready := io.device.a.ready
52	
53	  // Route D channel back to the correct host
54	  val hostSel = io.device.d.bits.source(tlp.sourceBits - 1, tlp.sourceBits - log2Ceil(nHosts))
55	  for (i <- 0 until nHosts) {
56	    io.host(i).d.valid := io.device.d.valid && (hostSel === i.U)
57	    io.host(i).d.bits  := io.device.d.bits
58	  }
59	  io.device.d.ready := MuxLookup(hostSel, false.B)(
60	    (0 until nHosts).map(i => i.U -> io.host(i).d.ready)
61	  )
62	}

20	
21	/**
22	  * AXI4 to TileLink-UL bridge.
23	  *
24	  * Converts an AXI4 master interface to a TL-UL host interface.
25	  * Supports single-beat read and write transactions.
26	  */
27	class Axi2TLUL(p: Parameters) extends Module {
28	  val tlp = new TLULParameters(p)
29	
30	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
31	    val axi = Flipped(new AxiMasterIO(tlp.addrBits, tlp.dataBits, tlp.sourceBits))
32	    val tl  = new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(tlp)
33	  })
34	
35	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
36	  // State machine
37	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
38	  val sIdle :: sWrAddr :: sWrData :: sTlWr :: sTlWrWait :: sTlRd :: sTlRdWait :: sWrResp :: sRdData :: Nil = Enum(9)
39	  val state = RegInit(sIdle)
40	
41	  val addrReg   = RegInit(0.U(tlp.addrBits.W))
42	  val dataReg   = RegInit(0.U(tlp.dataBits.W))
43	  val strbReg   = RegInit(0.U((tlp.dataBits / 8).W))
44	  val sizeReg   = RegInit(0.U(tlp.sizeBits.W))
45	  val idReg     = RegInit(0.U(tlp.sourceBits.W))
46	  val respReg   = RegInit(0.U(2.W))
47	  val rdDataReg = RegInit(0.U(tlp.dataBits.W))
48	
49	  // Default AXI outputs
50	  io.axi.read.addr.ready  := false.B
51	  io.axi.read.data.valid  := false.B
52	  io.axi.read.data.bits   := 0.U.asTypeOf(new AxiReadDataChannel(tlp.dataBits, tlp.sourceBits))
53	  io.axi.write.addr.ready := false.B
54	  io.axi.write.data.ready := false.B
55	  io.axi.write.resp.valid := false.B
56	  io.axi.write.resp.bits  := 0.U.asTypeOf(new AxiWriteRespChannel(tlp.sourceBits))
57	
58	  // Default TL outputs
59	  io.tl.a.valid     := false.B
60	  io.tl.a.bits      := 0.U.asTypeOf(new TLULChannelA(tlp))
61	  io.tl.d.ready     := false.B
62	
63	  switch(state) {
64	    is(sIdle) {
65	      // Prioritize writes
66	      when(io.axi.write.addr.valid && io.axi.write.data.valid) {
67	        io.axi.write.addr.ready := true.B
68	        io.axi.write.data.ready := true.B
69	        addrReg := io.axi.write.addr.bits.addr
70	        dataReg := io.axi.write.data.bits.data
71	        strbReg := io.axi.write.data.bits.strb
72	        sizeReg := io.axi.write.addr.bits.size
73	        idReg   := io.axi.write.addr.bits.id
74	        state   := sTlWr
75	      }.elsewhen(io.axi.read.addr.valid) {
76	        io.axi.read.addr.ready := true.B
77	        addrReg := io.axi.read.addr.bits.addr
78	        sizeReg := io.axi.read.addr.bits.size
79	        idReg   := io.axi.read.addr.bits.id
80	        state   := sTlRd
81	      }
82	    }
83	
84	    is(sTlWr) {
85	      io.tl.a.valid        := true.B
86	      io.tl.a.bits.opcode  := TLULOpcodesA.PutFullData
87	      io.tl.a.bits.param   := 0.U
88	      io.tl.a.bits.size    := sizeReg
89	      io.tl.a.bits.source  := idReg
90	      io.tl.a.bits.address := addrReg
91	      io.tl.a.bits.mask    := strbReg
92	      io.tl.a.bits.data    := dataReg
93	      io.tl.a.bits.corrupt := false.B
94	
95	      when(io.tl.a.ready) {
96	        state := sTlWrWait
97	      }
98	    }
99	
100	    is(sTlWrWait) {
101	      io.tl.d.ready := true.B
102	      when(io.tl.d.valid) {
103	        respReg := Mux(io.tl.d.bits.error, 2.U, 0.U)
104	        state   := sWrResp
105	      }
106	    }
107	
108	    is(sWrResp) {
109	      io.axi.write.resp.valid       := true.B
110	      io.axi.write.resp.bits.resp   := respReg
111	      io.axi.write.resp.bits.id     := idReg
112	      when(io.axi.write.resp.ready) {
113	        state := sIdle
114	      }
115	    }
116	
117	    is(sTlRd) {
118	      io.tl.a.valid        := true.B
119	      io.tl.a.bits.opcode  := TLULOpcodesA.Get
120	      io.tl.a.bits.param   := 0.U
121	      io.tl.a.bits.size    := sizeReg
122	      io.tl.a.bits.source  := idReg

Now I have a complete picture. Let me analyze all the potential issues I see:

1. **Spi2TLULV2.scala**: In the `SpiDomain`, the `io.enq_valid` and `io.enq_bits` are being driven in two places - the write path (`when(byteRdy)...when(payCnt === ...)`) and the read dispatch path (`when(rdPending && !byteRdy)`). Since both code blocks set these wires conditionally (with `WireDefault` at the top), there shouldn't be a multi-driver problem, BUT: the read dispatch is `when(rdPending && !byteRdy)` which should be fine.

2. **DmaEngine.scala**: The DMA state machine has a potential issue - when in `dWaitDesc` state and `descLoadIdx === 7.U`, the code reads `descWords(2)` for flags. But at this point `descWords(2)` has already been written in a previous iteration (when `descLoadIdx` was 2). However, the current word at index 7 (the reserved word) is stored in `descWords(descLoadIdx)` which should be fine since `descLoadIdx` is still 7 when we read `descWords(2)`.

   Wait - there's a critical issue: `descWords(descLoadIdx) := word` is written first before reading, but these are `Reg`s in Chisel, so the write only takes effect next cycle. On cycle where `descLoadIdx === 7`, we write `descWords(7) := word` and read `descWords(2)` which has the value from previous cycle. That's correct.

Now I notice a potential issue with the TLULTestUtils - it uses `tl.d.bits.error` directly but `TLULChannelD` has `error: Bool` while `OpenTitanTileLink.D_Channel` has `error: UInt(1.W)`. The test uses `Host2Device` which has `d: Flipped(Decoupled(new TLULChannelD(p)))`. So `tl.d.bits.error` is `Bool`. The comparison `tl.d.bits.error.peek().litValue != 0` should work for `Bool` too.

But wait - the test `DmaEngineTest.scala` uses `dut.io.tl_device` which is `Flipped(new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(deviceTlp))`. This is `Host2Device` which has `d: Flipped(Decoupled(new TLULChannelD(p)))`. So `d.bits.error` is `Bool`. The test does `dut.io.tl_device.d.bits.error.peek().litValue != 0` which should work.

Let me now look for one important issue - in the SpiMaster, the TL bus uses `OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device` which has `TLULChannelA` (not `A_Channel`). The `TLULChannelA` doesn't have a `user` field. So the test `tlRead`/`tlWrite` helpers use `Host2Device` which is correct.

The `SpiReqDesc` is also defined inside `Spi2TLULV2`. This should work in Chisel as inner classes can reference outer class members.

Let me verify the key behavioral issue in `Spi2TLULV2.scala`: When `byteRdy` is true and we complete a write beat (payCnt reaches BEAT_BYTES-1), we set `io.enq_valid := true.B`. Then separately, when `rdPending && !byteRdy`, we try to push read requests. These two branches are:
1. `when(byteRdy) { ... when(payCnt === BEAT_BYTES-1) { io.enq_valid := true.B; io.enq_bits := req } }`
2. `when(rdPending && !byteRdy) { when(io.enq_ready && !io.enq_valid) { io.enq_valid := true.B; io.enq_bits := req } }`

Since both use `WireDefault` at the top (`io.enq_valid := false.B`), and they're mutually exclusive (`!byteRdy` in branch 2), there's no multiple-driver issue - only one branch can set `io.enq_valid := true.B` per cycle. Good.

However, looking more carefully at branch 2: `when(io.enq_ready && !io.enq_valid)` - since `io.enq_valid` is a `WireDefault(false.B)` and we're in `!byteRdy` case, `io.enq_valid` at this point is still `false.B`. The `!io.enq_valid` check is redundant but harmless.

Now let me check if there are issues with the `hdrCnt` counter. When `hdrCnt === 6.U`, we process the complete header (7 bytes: indices 0..6). At this point:
- `hdrBuf(0)` = byte 0 (opcode), set when `hdrCnt === 0`
- `hdrBuf(1)` through `hdrBuf(5)` = bytes 1..5
- `byteVal` = the current byte (byte 6)
- `hdrBuf(6)` is NOT set yet in this cycle

Looking at `hdrBuf(hdrCnt) := byteVal` - when `hdrCnt === 6`, this sets `hdrBuf(6) := byteVal`. But then `when(hdrCnt === 6.U)` decodes:
```
val op    = hdrBuf(0)
val addr  = Cat(hdrBuf(1), hdrBuf(2), hdrBuf(3), hdrBuf(4))
val lf    = Cat(hdrBuf(5), byteVal)
```
This uses `hdrBuf(5)` (already stored from previous cycle when hdrCnt was 5) and `byteVal` as the 7th byte. This is the beats-1 MSB/LSB. The `lf = Cat(hdrBuf(5), byteVal)` = 16-bit big-endian beats-1 value.

Wait - `hdrBuf(hdrCnt) := byteVal` is a register assignment, so it takes effect next cycle. But the decode happens this same cycle using `hdrBuf(5)` and `byteVal`. Since `hdrBuf(5)` was written last cycle (when hdrCnt was 5), it has the correct value. Good.

But there's a subtlety: the decoding uses:
- `hdrBuf(0)` = byte 0 (opcode) - stored when hdrCnt was 0, so correct value is in register
- `hdrBuf(1..4)` = bytes 1..4 - correct
- `hdrBuf(5)` = byte 5 (stored when hdrCnt was 5) - correct
- `byteVal` = byte 6 (current) - correct

So `addr = Cat(hdrBuf(1), hdrBuf(2), hdrBuf(3), hdrBuf(4))`. That means:
- hdrBuf(1) = most significant address byte (address[31:24])
- hdrBuf(4) = least significant address byte (address[7:0])

The SPI protocol from the spec: "Bytes 1..4: address (big-endian 32-bit)". Byte 1 is MSB, byte 4 is LSB. `Cat(hdrBuf(1), hdrBuf(2), hdrBuf(3), hdrBuf(4))` = 32-bit big-endian address. Correct.

Now let me check if there are potential issues with the `Spi2TLULV2Test.scala` wrapper - the test wrapper instantiates `new Spi2TLULV2(p)` which expects `Parameters`. The test wrapper has:

```scala
p.lsuDataBits = 128
```
And `Spi2TLULV2` uses `class TLULParameters(p)` which reads `p.lsuDataBits`. OK.

The test wrapper uses `new OpenTitanTileLink.A_Channel(tlul_p)` and `new TLULChannelD(tlp)`. Wait - `v2.io.q_tl_a` is `Decoupled(new OpenTitanTileLink.A_Channel(tlp))` but in the wrapper, `respReq` is `Reg(... new OpenTitanTileLink.A_Channel(tlul_p))`. Then it does `v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.user := 0.U.asTypeOf(new OpenTitanTileLink_D_User)`.

The `q_tl_d` port in `Spi2TLULV2` is `Flipped(Decoupled(new OpenTitanTileLink.D_Channel(tlp)))`. The `D_Channel` has `.user: OpenTitanTileLink_D_User` and `.error: UInt(1.W)`. The test sets `v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.user` and `v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.error`. That's fine.

The issue is that the multi-line `val ... = Enum(9)` pattern doesn't work in Scala when split across multiple lines this way. Scala's semicolon inference treats line 151 as complete since `::` at the end would actually work... actually let me think again.

21	/**
22	  * SPI-to-TileLink-UL bridge (version 1).
23	  *
24	  * Frame format (MSB-first per byte, header then payload):
25	  *   Byte 0  : opcode (0x01=read, 0x02=write)
26	  *   Bytes 1..4 : address (big-endian 32-bit)
27	  *   Bytes 5..6 : beat_count minus 1 (big-endian 16-bit)
28	  *   Bytes 7..N : write payload (N = (beat_count) * 16 bytes), or nothing for read
29	  *
30	  * On read: MISO outputs 0xFE sync then 16 bytes of TL response per beat.
31	  */
32	class Spi2TLUL(p: Parameters) extends RawModule {
33	  val tlp = new TLULParameters(p)
34	
35	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
36	    val spi_clk   = Input(Clock())
37	    val spi_rst_n = Input(Bool())
38	
39	    // SPI pin queues (in SPI clock domain)
40	    val q_mosi_pin = Flipped(Decoupled(Bool()))
41	    val q_miso_pin = Decoupled(Bool())
42	
43	    // TileLink-UL master port (in system clock domain, but here we use single clock)
44	    val q_tl_a = Decoupled(new OpenTitanTileLink.A_Channel(tlp))
45	    val q_tl_d = Flipped(Decoupled(new OpenTitanTileLink.D_Channel(tlp)))
46	  })
47	
48	  withClockAndReset(io.spi_clk, (!io.spi_rst_n).asAsyncReset) {
49	    // Simple single-clock implementation (no CDC for Spi2TLUL v1)
50	    // Frame receive state machine
51	    val sHeader :: sPayload :: sTlTx :: sTlWait :: sMisoSync :: sMisoData :: Nil = Enum(6)
52	    val state = RegInit(sHeader)
53	
54	    val headerBuf = Reg(Vec(7, UInt(8.W)))  // 7 header bytes
55	    val headerIdx = RegInit(0.U(4.W))
56	
57	    val shiftByte = RegInit(0.U(8.W))
58	    val shiftCnt  = RegInit(0.U(4.W))   // 0..7 bits per byte
59	
60	    val beatCount   = RegInit(0.U(16.W))  // total beats
61	    val beatDone    = RegInit(0.U(16.W))  // beats completed
62	    val payloadBuf  = Reg(Vec(16, UInt(8.W)))
63	    val payloadIdx  = RegInit(0.U(5.W))  // 0..15
64	
65	    val opcode    = RegInit(0.U(8.W))
66	    val address   = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
67	    val numBeats  = RegInit(0.U(16.W))  // beat_count
68	
69	    val misoShift  = RegInit(0.U(8.W))
70	    val misoIdx    = RegInit(0.U(5.W))  // byte index in miso output
71	    val misobit    = RegInit(0.U(4.W))  // bit position 7..0
72	    val misoData   = Reg(Vec(16, UInt(8.W)))
73	    val misoSyncCnt = RegInit(0.U(4.W))

21	/**
22	  * TileLink-UL to AXI4 bridge.
23	  *
24	  * Converts TL-UL host requests to AXI4 master transactions.
25	  * Acts as a TL-UL device (slave) that issues AXI transactions.
26	  */
27	class TLUL2Axi(p: Parameters) extends Module {
28	  val tlp = new TLULParameters(p)
29	
30	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
31	    val tl  = Flipped(new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(tlp))
32	    val axi = new AxiMasterIO(tlp.addrBits, tlp.dataBits, tlp.sourceBits)
33	  })
34	
35	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
36	  // State machine
37	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
38	  val sIdle :: sWrAddr :: sWrData :: sWrResp :: sRdAddr :: sRdData :: Nil = Enum(6)
39	  val state = RegInit(sIdle)
40	
41	  val addrReg   = RegInit(0.U(tlp.addrBits.W))
42	  val dataReg   = RegInit(0.U(tlp.dataBits.W))
43	  val maskReg   = RegInit(0.U((tlp.dataBits / 8).W))
44	  val sizeReg   = RegInit(0.U(tlp.sizeBits.W))
45	  val sourceReg = RegInit(0.U(tlp.sourceBits.W))
46	  val rdDataReg = RegInit(0.U(tlp.dataBits.W))
47	  val errorReg  = RegInit(false.B)
48	
49	  // Default outputs
50	  io.tl.a.ready           := false.B
51	  io.tl.d.valid           := false.B
52	  io.tl.d.bits            := 0.U.asTypeOf(new TLULChannelD(tlp))
53	
54	  io.axi.read.addr.valid  := false.B
55	  io.axi.read.addr.bits   := 0.U.asTypeOf(new AxiReadAddrChannel(tlp.addrBits, tlp.sourceBits))
56	  io.axi.read.data.ready  := false.B
57	
58	  io.axi.write.addr.valid := false.B
59	  io.axi.write.addr.bits  := 0.U.asTypeOf(new AxiWriteAddrChannel(tlp.addrBits, tlp.sourceBits))
60	  io.axi.write.data.valid := false.B
61	  io.axi.write.data.bits  := 0.U.asTypeOf(new AxiWriteDataChannel(tlp.dataBits))
62	  io.axi.write.resp.ready := false.B
63	
64	  switch(state) {
65	    is(sIdle) {
66	      io.tl.a.ready := true.B
67	      when(io.tl.a.valid) {
68	        val isWrite = (io.tl.a.bits.opcode === TLULOpcodesA.PutFullData) ||
69	                      (io.tl.a.bits.opcode === TLULOpcodesA.PutPartialData)
70	        addrReg   := io.tl.a.bits.address
71	        dataReg   := io.tl.a.bits.data
72	        maskReg   := io.tl.a.bits.mask
73	        sizeReg   := io.tl.a.bits.size
74	        sourceReg := io.tl.a.bits.source
75	        when(isWrite) {
76	          state := sWrAddr
77	        }.otherwise {
78	          state := sRdAddr
79	        }
80	      }
81	    }
82	
83	    is(sWrAddr) {
84	      io.axi.write.addr.valid       := true.B
85	      io.axi.write.addr.bits.addr   := addrReg
86	      io.axi.write.addr.bits.size   := sizeReg
87	      io.axi.write.addr.bits.len    := 0.U
88	      io.axi.write.addr.bits.id     := sourceReg
89	      io.axi.write.addr.bits.burst  := 1.U  // INCR
90	      io.axi.write.addr.bits.lock   := 0.U
91	      io.axi.write.addr.bits.cache  := 0.U
92	      io.axi.write.addr.bits.prot   := 0.U
93	      io.axi.write.addr.bits.qos    := 0.U
94	      when(io.axi.write.addr.ready) {
95	        state := sWrData
96	      }
97	    }
98	
99	    is(sWrData) {
100	      io.axi.write.data.valid       := true.B
101	      io.axi.write.data.bits.data   := dataReg
102	      io.axi.write.data.bits.strb   := maskReg
103	      io.axi.write.data.bits.last   := true.B
104	      when(io.axi.write.data.ready) {
105	        state := sWrResp
106	      }
107	    }
108	
109	    is(sWrResp) {
110	      io.axi.write.resp.ready := true.B
111	      when(io.axi.write.resp.valid) {
112	        errorReg := io.axi.write.resp.bits.resp =/= 0.U
113	        state    := sIdle
114	        // Send TL-D response
115	        io.tl.d.valid        := true.B
116	        io.tl.d.bits.opcode  := TLULOpcodesD.AccessAck
117	        io.tl.d.bits.param   := 0.U
118	        io.tl.d.bits.size    := sizeReg
119	        io.tl.d.bits.source  := sourceReg
120	        io.tl.d.bits.sink    := 0.U
121	        io.tl.d.bits.denied  := false.B
122	        io.tl.d.bits.data    := 0.U
123	        io.tl.d.bits.corrupt := false.B
124	        io.tl.d.bits.error   := io.axi.write.resp.bits.resp =/= 0.U
125	      }
126	    }
127	
128	    is(sRdAddr) {
129	      io.axi.read.addr.valid       := true.B
130	      io.axi.read.addr.bits.addr   := addrReg
131	      io.axi.read.addr.bits.size   := sizeReg
132	      io.axi.read.addr.bits.len    := 0.U
133	      io.axi.read.addr.bits.id     := sourceReg
134	      io.axi.read.addr.bits.burst  := 1.U  // INCR
135	      io.axi.read.addr.bits.lock   := 0.U
136	      io.axi.read.addr.bits.cache  := 0.U
137	      io.axi.read.addr.bits.prot   := 0.U
138	      io.axi.read.addr.bits.qos    := 0.U
139	      when(io.axi.read.addr.ready) {
140	        state := sRdData
141	      }
142	    }
143	
144	    is(sRdData) {
145	      io.axi.read.data.ready := true.B
146	      when(io.axi.read.data.valid) {
147	        rdDataReg := io.axi.read.data.bits.data
148	        errorReg  := io.axi.read.data.bits.resp =/= 0.U
149	        state     := sIdle
150	        // Send TL-D response
151	        io.tl.d.valid        := true.B
152	        io.tl.d.bits.opcode  := TLULOpcodesD.AccessAckData
153	        io.tl.d.bits.param   := 0.U
154	        io.tl.d.bits.size    := sizeReg
155	        io.tl.d.bits.source  := sourceReg
156	        io.tl.d.bits.sink    := 0.U
157	        io.tl.d.bits.denied  := false.B
158	        io.tl.d.bits.data    := io.axi.read.data.bits.data
159	        io.tl.d.bits.corrupt := false.B
160	        io.tl.d.bits.error   := io.axi.read.data.bits.resp =/= 0.U
161	      }
162	    }
163	  }
164	}

21	/**
22	  * TileLink-UL width conversion bridge.
23	  *
24	  * Converts between two TL-UL buses of different data widths.
25	  * The narrow side is the host (requestor) and the wide side is the device.
26	  *
27	  * This implementation handles the common case of 2:1 width ratio by
28	  * splitting wide writes and merging narrow reads.
29	  *
30	  * @param narrowP Parameters for the narrow (host) side
31	  * @param wideP   Parameters for the wide (device) side
32	  */
33	class TlulWidthBridge(narrowP: Parameters, wideP: Parameters) extends Module {
34	  val narrowTlp = new TLULParameters(narrowP)
35	  val wideTlp   = new TLULParameters(wideP)
36	
37	  require(wideTlp.dataBits >= narrowTlp.dataBits, "Wide bus must be >= narrow bus")
38	  val ratio = wideTlp.dataBits / narrowTlp.dataBits
39	
40	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
41	    val narrow = Flipped(new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(narrowTlp))  // host side
42	    val wide   = new OpenTitanTileLink.Host2Device(wideTlp)              // device side
43	  })
44	
45	  if (ratio == 1) {
46	    // Pass-through with type conversion
47	    io.wide.a.valid          := io.narrow.a.valid
48	    io.wide.a.bits.opcode    := io.narrow.a.bits.opcode
49	    io.wide.a.bits.param     := io.narrow.a.bits.param
50	    io.wide.a.bits.size      := io.narrow.a.bits.size
51	    io.wide.a.bits.source    := io.narrow.a.bits.source
52	    io.wide.a.bits.address   := io.narrow.a.bits.address
53	    io.wide.a.bits.mask      := io.narrow.a.bits.mask
54	    io.wide.a.bits.data      := io.narrow.a.bits.data
55	    io.wide.a.bits.corrupt   := io.narrow.a.bits.corrupt
56	    io.narrow.a.ready        := io.wide.a.ready
57

The combinational cycle is: `io.enq_valid <- ... <- io.enq_valid`. 

The cycle comes from:
```scala
when(io.enq_ready && !io.enq_valid) {
  io.enq_valid := true.B
```

Here, `io.enq_valid` (a `WireDefault(false.B)`) is read in the condition `!io.enq_valid` and also written inside. In Chisel's semantics, `WireDefault(false.B)` means the wire starts at `false.B` as default. But then `io.enq_valid` is set within the `when` block, and the condition reads from the wire `io.enq_valid` again. 

Actually in Chisel, when you read `io.enq_valid` in the condition, it reads the current value of the wire. But if `io.enq_valid` can be driven from both the write-beat path and this read-dispatch path, and the read-dispatch path checks `!io.enq_valid` (its own previous assignment), this creates a circular dependency.

The key issue: `io.enq_valid` is declared as `WireDefault(false.B)` at the top of `SpiDomain`. The `!io.enq_valid` condition in the read-dispatch block checks whether the write-beat path already set `io.enq_valid := true.B`. But the write-beat path only fires when `byteRdy && payCnt == BEAT_BYTES-1`, and the read-dispatch path only fires when `!byteRdy`. They're mutually exclusive, but firtool sees both paths writing to `io.enq_valid` and reading from it, creating a detected cycle.

The fix: Remove the `!io.enq_valid` guard in the read-dispatch block since it's redundant (we know `io.enq_valid` is false when `!byteRdy` prevents the write-beat path from executing). The `!io.enq_valid` check creates the cycle:

`io.enq_valid` depends on `(!io.enq_valid)` which depends on `io.enq_valid` itself.

24	// Test wrapper module — replicates spi_v2_tb_top.sv in Chisel
25	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
26	
27	class Spi2TLULV2TestWrapper extends Module {
28	  val io = IO(new Bundle {
29	    val spi_clk_in = Input(Bool())
30	    val spi_csb    = Input(Bool())
31	    val spi_mosi   = Input(Bool())
32	    val spi_miso   = Output(Bool())
33	
34	    // TL-A capture outputs (last beat)
35	    val tl_a_captured    = Output(Bool())
36	    val tl_a_cap_opcode  = Output(UInt(3.W))
37	    val tl_a_cap_address = Output(UInt(32.W))
38	    val tl_a_cap_data    = Output(UInt(128.W))
39	    val tl_a_cap_count   = Output(UInt(32.W))
40	
41	    // TL-A first-beat capture + reset
42	    val tl_a_first_address = Output(UInt(32.W))
43	    val tl_a_first_data    = Output(UInt(128.W))
44	    val tl_a_first_reset   = Input(Bool())
45	  })
46	
47	  var p = new Parameters()
48	  p.lsuDataBits = 128
49	  val tlul_p = new TLULParameters(p)
50	  val v2     = Module(new Spi2TLULV2(p))
51	
52	  // Clock and reset wiring
53	  v2.io.spi_clk   := io.spi_clk_in.asClock
54	  v2.io.spi_rst_n := !io.spi_csb
55	
56	  // MOSI: always valid, data from spi_mosi
57	  v2.io.q_mosi_pin.valid := true.B
58	  v2.io.q_mosi_pin.bits  := io.spi_mosi
59	
60	  // MISO: always ready, output gated by valid
61	  v2.io.q_miso_pin.ready := true.B
62	  io.spi_miso            := Mux(v2.io.q_miso_pin.valid, v2.io.q_miso_pin.bits, false.B)
63	
64	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
65	  // TileLink auto-responder (mirrors spi_v2_tb_top.sv)
66	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
67	  // V2 TL-A is 217 bits: Cat(opcode(3), param(3), size(4), source(8),
68	  //   addr(32), mask(16), data(128), user(23))
69	  // V2 TL-D is 162 bits: Cat(opcode(3), param(3), size(4), source(8),
70	  //   sink(1), data(128), user(14), error(1))
71	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
72	  val TL_GET             = 4.U(3.W)
73	  val TL_ACCESS_ACK      = 0.U(3.W)
74	  val TL_ACCESS_ACK_DATA = 1.U(3.W)
75	
76	  val respPending = RegInit(false.B)
77	  val respReq     = RegInit(0.U.asTypeOf(new OpenTitanTileLink.A_Channel(tlul_p)))
78	  val tlAReady    = RegInit(true.B)
79	
80	  v2.io.q_tl_a.ready := tlAReady
81	
82	  val aValid = v2.io.q_tl_a.valid
83	  val aData  = v2.io.q_tl_a.bits
84	
85	  // Single-driver style: accept A → latch + deassert ready; D handshake → clear + reassert
86	  val acceptA   = aValid && tlAReady && !respPending
87	  val completeD = respPending && v2.io.q_tl_d.ready
88	
89	  respPending := Mux(acceptA, true.B, Mux(completeD, false.B, respPending))
90	  respReq     := Mux(acceptA, aData, respReq)
91	  tlAReady    := Mux(acceptA, false.B, Mux(completeD, true.B, tlAReady))
92	
93	  // Decode latched request (217-bit positions)
94	  val reqOpcode = respReq.opcode
95	  val reqParam  = respReq.param
96	  val reqSize   = respReq.size
97	  val reqSource = respReq.source
98	  val reqAddr   = respReq.address
99	
100	  val respOpcode =
101	    Mux(reqOpcode === TLULOpcodesA.Get.asUInt, TLULOpcodesD.AccessAckData, TLULOpcodesD.AccessAck)
102	  val respData = Cat(0.U(96.W), reqAddr)
103	
104	  v2.io.q_tl_d.valid       := respPending
105	  v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.opcode := respOpcode.asUInt
106	  v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.param  := 0.U(3.W)
107	  v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.size   := reqSize
108	  v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.source := reqSource
109	  v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.sink   := 0.U(1.W)
110	  v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.data   := respData
111	  v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.user   := 0.U.asTypeOf(new OpenTitanTileLink_D_User)
112	  v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.error  := 0.U(1.W)
113	
114	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
115	  // TL-A capture registers (latch on A-channel handshake)
116	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
117	  val aHandshake = aValid && tlAReady
118	  val captured   = RegInit(false.B)
119	  val capOpcode  = RegInit(0.U(3.W))
120	  val capAddress = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
121	  val capData    = RegInit(0.U(128.W))
122	  val capCount   = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
123	
124	  // First-beat capture: latched on the first handshake after count was last
125	  // snapshot by the test (i.e., the first beat of each multi-beat burst).
126	  val firstCapAddress = RegInit(0.U(32.W))
127	  val firstCapData    = RegInit(0.U(128.W))
128	  val firstCapDone    = RegInit(false.B)
129	
130	  captured   := Mux(aHandshake, true.B, captured)
131	  capOpcode  := Mux(aHandshake, aData.opcode, capOpcode)
132	  capAddress := Mux(aHandshake, aData.address, capAddress)
133	  capData    := Mux(aHandshake, aData.data, capData)
134	  capCount   := Mux(aHandshake, capCount + 1.U, capCount)
135	
136	  when(io.tl_a_first_reset) {
137	    firstCapDone    := false.B
138	    firstCapAddress := 0.U
139	    firstCapData    := 0.U
140	  }.elsewhen(aHandshake && !firstCapDone) {
141	    firstCapAddress := aData.address
142	    firstCapData    := aData.data
143	    firstCapDone    := true.B
144	  }
145	
146	  io.tl_a_captured      := captured
147	  io.tl_a_cap_opcode    := capOpcode
148	  io.tl_a_cap_address   := capAddress
149	  io.tl_a_cap_data      := capData
150	  io.tl_a_cap_count     := capCount
151	  io.tl_a_first_address := firstCapAddress
152	  io.tl_a_first_data    := firstCapData
153	}

159	class Spi2TLULV2Spec extends AnyFreeSpec with ChiselSim {
160	
161	  // Sys clock period = 10 units (SYS_HALF=5), SPI period = 13 units (SPI_HALF=6.5).
162	  // We use integer ratio: SYS_HALF=10, SPI_HALF=13.
163	  // Each clock.step(1) is one "sim unit". SPI toggles when the phase counter says so.
164	  val SYS_HALF = 10
165	  val SPI_HALF = 13
166	
167	  /** Run the simulation with dual-clock stepping. The main clock.step() drives the sys domain. SPI
168	    * clock is toggled as a Bool input at a 10:13 ratio to approximate truly async clocks.
169	    */
170	  def withDualClock(body: Spi2TLULV2TestWrapper => Unit): Unit = {
171	    simulate(new Spi2TLULV2TestWrapper) { dut =>
172	      // Reset — toggle SPI clock during reset so system-reset-only
173	      // CDC FIFOs (clocked by spi_clk) see the reset posedge.
174	      dut.reset.poke(true.B)
175	      dut.io.spi_csb.poke(true.B)
176	      dut.io.spi_mosi.poke(false.B)
177	      dut.io.spi_clk_in.poke(false.B)
178	      dut.io.tl_a_first_reset.poke(false.B)
179	      for (_ <- 0 until 5) {
180	        dut.io.spi_clk_in.poke(true.B)
181	        dut.clock.step(1)
182	        dut.io.spi_clk_in.poke(false.B)
183	        dut.clock.step(1)
184	      }
185	      dut.reset.poke(false.B)
186	      dut.clock.step(5)
187	
188	      body(dut)
189	    }
190	  }
191	
192	  /** Dual-clock tick state — tracks when to toggle SPI clock relative to sys clock. */
193	  class DualClockState(dut: Spi2TLULV2TestWrapper) {
194	    var sysTime: Long     = 0
195	    var nextSysEdge: Long = SYS_HALF
196	    var nextSpiEdge: Long = SPI_HALF
197	    var spiLevel: Boolean = false
198	
199	    /** Advance one sim time unit, toggling whichever clock(s) fire. Returns 's', 'p', or 'b'. */
200	    def tick(): Char = {

200	    def tick(): Char = {
201	      if (nextSysEdge < nextSpiEdge) {
202	        sysTime = nextSysEdge
203	        nextSysEdge += SYS_HALF
204	        dut.clock.step(1)
205	        's'
206	      } else if (nextSpiEdge < nextSysEdge) {
207	        sysTime = nextSpiEdge
208	        spiLevel = !spiLevel
209	        dut.io.spi_clk_in.poke(spiLevel.B)
210	        nextSpiEdge += SPI_HALF
211	        // Don't step sys clock — just toggle SPI
212	        // But we need at least one eval to propagate. Step sys clock to advance simulation.
213	        dut.clock.step(1)
214	        'p'
215	      } else {
216	        // Both edges coincide
217	        sysTime = nextSysEdge
218	        spiLevel = !spiLevel
219	        dut.io.spi_clk_in.poke(spiLevel.B)
220	        nextSysEdge += SYS_HALF
221	        nextSpiEdge += SPI_HALF
222	        dut.clock.step(1)
223	        'b'
224	      }
225	    }
226	
227	    /** Advance until n SPI posedges have occurred. */
228	    def spiCycles(n: Int): Unit = {
229	      var count = 0
230	      while (count < n) {
231	        val w = tick()
232	        if ((w == 'p' || w == 'b') && spiLevel) count += 1
233	      }
234	    }
235	
236	    /** Advance until n sys posedges have occurred. */
237	    def bothCycles(n: Int): Unit = {
238	      var count = 0
239	      while (count < n) {
240	        val w = tick()
241	        if (w == 's' || w == 'b') count += 1
242	      }
243	    }
244	
245	    // SPI protocol helpers
246	
247	    def spiXferByte(tx: Int): Unit = {
248	      for (bit <- 7 to 0 by -1) {
249	        dut.io.spi_mosi.poke((((tx >> bit) & 1) != 0).B)
250	        spiCycles(1)
251	      }
252	    }
253	
254	    def spiRecvByte(): Int = {
255	      var rx = 0
256	      for (_ <- 7 to 0 by -1) {
257	        dut.io.spi_mosi.poke(false.B)
258	        spiCycles(1)
259	        rx = (rx << 1) | (if (dut.io.spi_miso.peek().litValue != 0) 1 else 0)
260	      }
261	      rx
262	    }
263	
264	    def csbAssert(): Unit = {
265	      dut.io.spi_csb.poke(false.B)
266	      dut.io.spi_mosi.poke(false.B)
267	    }
268	
269	    def csbDeassert(): Unit = {
270	      dut.io.spi_mosi.poke(false.B)
271	      // Let DmaEngine finish draining CDC FIFOs before CSB deasserts
272	      // (AsyncQueue safe mode coordinates reset on CSB deassert)
273	      bothCycles(500)
274	      dut.io.spi_csb.poke(true.B)
275	      bothCycles(50)
276	    }
277	
278	    def spiSendHeader(op: Int, addr: Long, len: Int): Unit = {
279	      spiXferByte(op & 0xff)
280	      spiXferByte(((addr >> 24) & 0xff).toInt)
281	      spiXferByte(((addr >> 16) & 0xff).toInt)
282	      spiXferByte(((addr >> 8) & 0xff).toInt)
283	      spiXferByte((addr & 0xff).toInt)
284	      spiXferByte((len >> 8) & 0xff)
285	      spiXferByte(len & 0xff)
286	    }
287	
288	    /** Collect n raw MISO bits. Returns array of bytes packed MSB-first per byte. */
289	    def collectMisoBits(nbits: Int): Array[Int] = {
290	      val buf = new Array[Int]((nbits + 7) / 8)
291	      for (i <- 0 until nbits) {
292	        dut.io.spi_mosi.poke(false.B)
293	        spiCycles(1)
294	        val byteIdx = i / 8
295	        val bitIdx  = 7 - (i % 8)
296	        if (dut.io.spi_miso.peek().litValue != 0) {
297	          buf(byteIdx) |= (1 << bitIdx)
298	        }
299	      }
300	      buf
301	    }
302	
303	    /** Wait for TL-A capture count to reach expected value. */
304	    def waitTlACapture(expectedCount: Long, timeoutSys: Int = 200): Boolean = {
305	      var sc = 0
306	      while (sc < timeoutSys) {
307	        val w = tick()
308	        if (w == 's' || w == 'b') {
309	          sc += 1
310	          if (dut.io.tl_a_cap_count.peek().litValue >= expectedCount) return true
311	        }
312	      }
313	      false
314	    }
315	
316	    /** Reset the first-beat capture registers so the next A-channel handshake is captured. */
317	    def resetFirstCapture(): Unit = {
318	      dut.io.tl_a_first_reset.poke(true.B)
319	      dut.clock.step(1)
320	      dut.io.tl_a_first_reset.poke(false.B)
321	    }
322	
323	    /** Send a multi-beat write frame: header(op=0x02, addr, len=numBeats-1) + numBeats*16 payload
324	      * bytes.
325	      */
326	    def spiWriteMulti(addr: Long, beats: Seq[Array[Int]]): Unit = {
327	      csbAssert()
328	      spiSendHeader(0x02, addr, beats.length - 1)
329	      for (beat <- beats; byte <- beat) spiXferByte(byte)
330	      csbDeassert()
331	    }
332	
333	  }
334	
335	  /** Search for a bit pattern (needle) in a bit buffer (haystack). Both are packed MSB-first per
336	    * byte. Returns bit offset or -1.
337	    */
338	  def findBitPattern(
339	      haystack: Array[Int],
340	      hayBits: Int,
341	      needle: Array[Int],
342	      needleBits: Int
343	  ): Int = {
344	    for (off <- 0 to (hayBits - needleBits)) {
345	      var matched = true
346	      var b       = 0
347	      while (b < needleBits && matched) {
348	        val hi     = off + b
349	        val hayBit = (haystack(hi / 8) >> (7 - (hi % 8))) & 1
350	        val ndlBit = (needle(b / 8) >> (7 - (b     % 8))) & 1
351	        if (hayBit != ndlBit) matched = false
352	        b += 1
353	      }
354	      if (matched) return off

0x55 = 0b01010101
0x2b = 0b00101011

That's 0x55 shifted right by 1 bit and masked, or: 0x55 >> 1 = 0x2A, nope. 

Actually 0x2b = 0b00101011. And 0x55 = 0b01010101. These don't have a simple relationship.

But wait: 0b00101011 looks like... the bits of 0x55 are wrong. Let me think about what could cause this.

The loopback test: `dut.io.spi.miso.poke(dut.io.spi.mosi.peek())` and step for 100 cycles. This is a combinational loopback - each clock cycle, MISO = MOSI from the previous cycle.

In Mode 0 (CPOL=0, CPHA=0):
- Clock starts low (CPOL=0)
- Data is valid on leading edge (CPHA=0 = sample on rising edge)
- Data is shifted out on trailing edge (falling edge)

My SpiMasterCtrl FSM:
```scala
val isLeadingEdge = Mux(cpol, sclkReg, !sclkReg)
val sampleOnThisEdge = Mux(cpha, !isLeadingEdge, isLeadingEdge)
when(sampleOnThisEdge) {
  rxShift := Cat(rxShift(6, 0), io.spi.miso)
  when(bitCnt === 7.U) { spiState := spiDone }
  .otherwise { bitCnt := bitCnt + 1.U }
}.otherwise {
  when(bitCnt < 7.U) { mosiReg := shiftReg(6.U - bitCnt) }
```

For CPOL=0, CPHA=0:

Wait, `sclkReg` is the OLD value before toggle. So:
- When `sclkReg = 0` (was low), we're about to toggle to 1 (rising edge). `isLeadingEdge = !sclkReg = !0 = true`.
- When `sclkReg = 1` (was high), we're about to toggle to 0 (falling edge). `isLeadingEdge = !sclkReg = !1 = false`.

For CPOL=0, CPHA=0: `sampleOnThisEdge = Mux(0, !isLeadingEdge, isLeadingEdge) = isLeadingEdge`. So we sample on the leading (rising) edge. ✓

MOSI is changed on the trailing (falling) edge. When NOT sampling (trailing edge), we do:

```scala
  mosiReg  := txFifo.io.deq.bits(7)  // MSB first
```

- `rxShift := Cat(rxShift(6,0), miso)` - samples bit 7 (MSB first)

- `bitCnt < 7? 1 < 7 = true`

61	  v2.io.q_miso_pin.ready := true.B
62	  io.spi_miso            := Mux(v2.io.q_miso_pin.valid, v2.io.q_miso_pin.bits, false.B)
63

65	  // TileLink auto-responder (mirrors spi_v2_tb_top.sv)
66	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
67	  // V2 TL-A is 217 bits: Cat(opcode(3), param(3), size(4), source(8),
68	  //   addr(32), mask(16), data(128), user(23))
69	  // V2 TL-D is 162 bits: Cat(opcode(3), param(3), size(4), source(8),
70	  //   sink(1), data(128), user(14), error(1))
71	  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

73	  val TL_ACCESS_ACK      = 0.U(3.W)
74	  val TL_ACCESS_ACK_DATA = 1.U(3.W)
75

77	  val respReq     = RegInit(0.U.asTypeOf(new OpenTitanTileLink.A_Channel(tlul_p)))
78	  val tlAReady    = RegInit(true.B)
79	
80	  v2.io.q_tl_a.ready := tlAReady
81	
82	  val aValid = v2.io.q_tl_a.valid
83	  val aData  = v2.io.q_tl_a.bits
84	
85	  // Single-driver style: accept A → latch + deassert ready; D handshake → clear + reassert
86	  val acceptA   = aValid && tlAReady && !respPending
87	  val completeD = respPending && v2.io.q_tl_d.ready
88	
89	  respPending := Mux(acceptA, true.B, Mux(completeD, false.B, respPending))
90	  respReq     := Mux(acceptA, aData, respReq)
91	  tlAReady    := Mux(acceptA, false.B, Mux(completeD, true.B, tlAReady))

95	  val reqParam  = respReq.param
96	  val reqSize   = respReq.size
97	  val reqSource = respReq.source
98	  val reqAddr   = respReq.address
99	
100	  val respOpcode =
101	    Mux(reqOpcode === TLULOpcodesA.Get.asUInt, TLULOpcodesD.AccessAckData, TLULOpcodesD.AccessAck)
102	  val respData = Cat(0.U(96.W), reqAddr)

104	  v2.io.q_tl_d.valid       := respPending

106	  v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.param  := 0.U(3.W)
107	  v2.io.q_tl_d.bits.size   := reqSize
